contract.truth: same-sensor measured-position proxy, not independent physical truth
contract.scoring_arcs: Existing independently screened contact-free observed arcs; incoming negative-X arcs for primary comparison; annotation boundaries never supplied to replay
contract.inputs: All original frames and absent observations in chronological order; recorded quaternion when finite and normalized; no future spin or positions supplied to replay
contract.profiles: Main model21800_hardware and packetizer checked-in parameters; V2 existing managed defaults, shared unchanged physics; no PPQ004 all-data calibration adoption

methods.main_operator: Production LaptopPlayState observation admission, generation/bounce resets, BatchPhysicsEstimator, SpinEstimator and FutureContactPredictor; diagnostic same-cutoff queries, not published command counts
methods.main_batch: Same production batch estimator and predictor without operator gate, persistent across take; diagnostic only
methods.v2_managed: Production V2IncomingCoordinator observation-only persistent owner, continuous forecast and strike candidate; no annotation START/CONTEXT/CONTACT inputs

contract.metrics: Paired native plane position/time error at identical actual cutoffs; paired common-kernel free-flight position error using each current fitted state/spin; per-method and paired availability
contract.aggregation: Within-arc RMS then equal-weight arc median; primary pairing main_operator versus v2_managed; main_batch comparison separately; paired bootstrap resamples arcs, 5000 draws seed 140126; source frames are not independent trials
contract.winner_rule: Directional evidence requires paired median difference bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero with at least 5 holdout arcs; any reduced availability must be reported and prevents an unqualified overall winner claim; no threshold/model tuning after scoring
contract.scope_limits: Native prediction accuracy, not ROS latency, full command delivery, racket execution or hardware qualification; one holdout recording cannot establish cross-session generalization
